name: Wyatt's Tweaked Apps
subtitle: Auto-built YouMod and Chroma IPAs
description: Unofficial, automatically rebuilt IPAs: YouTube with YouMod (pre-release branch) and Spotify with Chroma, optionally with EeveeSpotify. Builds update on their own when the tweaks do.

apps.name: YouMod Pre-release
apps.subtitle: YouTube with the latest pre-release YouMod
apps.localizedDescription: YouTube with YouMod built from the pre-release branch, so you get new features and fixes before they reach a stable release. Bundled with YTUHD (+ YTVideoOverlay), Return YouTube Dislikes and DontEatMyContent. Pre-release builds may be unstable.

apps.subtitle: Chroma 1.2.0-beta.3 · Spotify 9.1.98

versions.localizedDescription: Spotify 9.1.90 + Chroma 1.1.0-beta.2 + Watch app. Older Chroma: the newest (Chroma 1.2.0-beta.3 for Spotify 9.1.98) is waiting on a decrypted Spotify IPA. This updates automatically once one is available.

apps.name: Spotify + Chroma + Watch (Chroma 1.2.0-beta.3)
apps.localizedDescription: Spotify patched with Chroma (chroma.pw): shaders behind the player, word-by-word lyrics, lock-screen lyrics and more. The Watch app is included (experimental: needs a paid Apple ID and a signer that installs Watch apps). Rebuilt automatically when Chroma updates.
